newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile lists fiscal '97 sales plan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile lists fiscal '97 sales plan.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center listed the following materials for sale under its Annual Materials Plan (AMP) for fiscal 1997. The AMP lists the maximum quantity of material which may be sold from Oct 1 through Sept 30, 1997.
Aluminum Oxide, abrasive grain 6,000 short tons
Aluminum Oxice, fused crude 30,000 short tons
Bauxite, metallurgical, jamaican 600,000 long dry tons
Bauxite, metallurgical, surinam 300,000 long dry tons
Bauxite, metallurgical, jamaican 600,000 long dry tons
Fluorspar, acid grade 100,000 short dry tons
Fluorspar, metallurgical grade 150,000 short dry tons
Manganese, bat. grade natural 60,000 short dry tons
Manganese, bat. grade synthetic 3,011 short dry tons
Manganese, chemical grade 40,000 short dry tons
Manganese, metallurgical grade 400,000 short dry tons
Vegetable tannin extract, chestnut 5,000 long tons
Vegetable tannin extract, quebracho 5,000 long tons
Vegetable tannin extract, wattl e 5,000 long tons
A-sales currently suspended pending environmental impact analysis.
B-environmental problems may preclude revenue-producing sale.
